# Jeju Duckgu Samseong (제주덕구 삼성점)

> Jeju pork BBQ restaurant near COEX and Samseong Station, Gangnam, Seoul. Staff grill Jeju pork (delivered from Jeju three times a week) at your table. 제주덕구 삼성점은 삼성역·코엑스 근처에서 제주에서 주 3회 직송받은 제주돼지를 직원이 직접 구워 드리는 고깃집입니다.

- Address: 1F, 23-9 Samseong-ro 100-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, Korea / 서울 강남구 삼성로100길 23-9 1층
- Phone: +82-507-1460-8793
- Hours: Mon–Fri 11:00–22:00 (break 14:30–16:00), Sat 16:00–22:00, closed Sundays
- Nearest stations: Samseong Jungang (Line 9) Exit 5, ~7 min walk; Samseong (Line 2) Exit 5, ~10–11 min walk
- About 170 m (straight line) from COEX, 513 Yeongdong-daero
- Prices (KRW): Jeju pork belly or neck 200 g 19,000; sets 63,000–192,000; weekday lunch from 10,900
- Groups: separate 16-seat and 20-seat areas; full buyout ~36–40 people
- Menus in English, Japanese and Chinese are available
- Facts last checked: 2026-10-12; menu prices as of 2026-10-03
- Naver Place: https://m.place.naver.com/restaurant/1532958694/home
